observations.title: Select a pregeneration area
observations.player_action: As an operator, select the world, shape, center and radius, then inspect chunky selection before chunky start.
observations.outcome: A generation task prepares chunks in the selected area; worldborder and spawn can supply the selection.
conditions: Command arguments differ by platform/version; use the installed Forge help, not a Bukkit world name assumed from a web example.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Administrative task progress and generated chunks are native Chunky signals, not inventory tasks. No pregeneration, trimming or world mutation was executed.

observations.title: Pause and resume generation
observations.player_action: Use chunky pause, then chunky continue when generation should resume.
observations.outcome: Pause preserves task progress for later continuation; chunky cancel ends the task instead.

observations.title: Distinguish generation from trimming
observations.player_action: Inspect the selected area before considering chunky trim.
observations.outcome: Trimming deletes chunks outside a selection and is a distinct destructive operation, not a way to pregenerate.
